observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a bare used engine/transmission assembly with wiring harness, hoses and seatbelt webbing draped over it, sitting on a dirt/concrete floor.
Photo 2 shows a plastic engine cover with 'V6' handwritten/printed and some chalk marks, no engine code or VIN plate legible.
No AC compressor is clearly visible or labeled as such in any photo; only hoses, throttle body, alternator and wiring are visible.
Engine appears partly wrapped in plastic film, consistent with import packaging, but no shipping label, customs sticker or Belgium-origin marking is visible.
Watermark 'NZ JAPANESE AUTOS' overlays all photos, indicating a dealer listing photo set, not necessarily this exact unit's provenance.
Seller's new message is text only, repeating the original claims with no new photo or video evidence.
